title: Simplify RLHF as Reward-Weighted SFT: A Variational Method

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing the average output sequence lengths of models aligned with different methods (e.g., VAR vs. DPO) across subsets of the Helpful and Harmless Assistant (HHA) benchmark to evaluate if the models exploit the reward model's tendency to incorrectly favor longer, more verbose sequences.
